instruction: Set the palm-sized phone with glossy finish on the dark green phonestand.

source.instruction: Set the palm-sized phone with glossy finish on the dark green phonestand.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the RIGHT arm grasped the phone, which was at x = +22 (right half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.

frames.label: turn 1
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.93; RIGHT fingertips (31, -19, 94) opening 0.93; table z = 74
frames.plan: orient right gripper downward, rotate yaw to match phone angle, and move above the phone to (23, -1, 94)
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (-8, +18, +0) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +19 cm (vertical) from the phone

frames.label: turn 2
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (23, -1, 94) opening 0.95; table z = 74
frames.plan: lower right arm closer to phone at z = 84 cm
frames.effect: RIGHT fingertips moved by (+0, +0, -11) cm, now 0 cm (horizontal) / +8 cm (vertical) from the phone

frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (23, -1, 78) opening 0.94; table z = 74

frames.label: turn 5
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (23, -1, 78) opening 0.82; table z = 74

frames.label: turn 6
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (21, 5, 100) opening 0.83; table z = 74

frames.label: turn 7
frames.state: LEFT fingertips (-30, -19, 94) opening 0.94; RIGHT fingertips (1, 9, 100) opening 0.83; table z = 74
frames.plan: adjust phone orientation and position slightly before sliding onto stand
